scoring_rules: A positive case may return only SYNTHETIC_UNIT_LAYOUT_PASS.
Every adversarial mutation is rejected or blocked from promotion exactly as declared.
No room geometry, activity mapping or topology pass is promoted into accessibility, fire, egress, structure, acoustic, daylight, thermal, service or code qualification.
All measurements and resident requirements not supplied by the source remain UNKNOWN or NOT_SUPPLIED.
Authored manifest is not execution evidence.
